name: Eyes
author: jesusarchive
description: Two eyes in the Omarchy bar that track the pointer across every monitor.

barWidget.description: Two xeyes-style eyes that track the pointer across every monitor. The drawing uses the proportions from X.Org's Eyes.c. The pair rotates when the bar is vertical.

schema.label: Samples per second
schema.description: Number of cursor-position requests sent to Hyprland each second. Lower values use less CPU but produce larger steps.

schema.label: Eye height (px)
schema.description: Height of the eyes in bar pixels. 0 fits them to the bar height.

schema.label: Eye shape
schema.description: Stretched uses the proportions of xeyes' default 150x100 window. Round uses circles.

schema.label: Look into the distance
schema.description: Scale pupil travel by the cursor's distance across the screen. Xeyes disables this option by default.

schema.label: Rim color
schema.description: Leave empty for black. Use "theme" for the bar foreground or enter a color such as #ff0000.

schema.label: Eye color
schema.description: Leave empty for white. Use "theme" for the bar background or enter a color.

schema.label: Pupil color
schema.description: Leave empty for black. Use "theme" for the bar foreground or enter a color.

schema.label: Left click command
schema.description: Run this shell command on left click. Leave empty to disable the action.
